why: Turns a `&'static BakedBootConfig` into the `Option`-per-field `BootConfig` the resolver consumes: validates magic + version, then yields `Some` for each field whose `set_flags` bit is set, taking strings up to the first NUL and treating invalid UTF-8 in a set field as unset. This is the READ half of the asymmetry recorded at `c:boot_config_node_name` -- it reads all four fields where C reads one.
